svg.text: P1B Master Architecture — Deterministic Institutional Expectation-Failure Intelligence Platform
Curated datasets, certified fixtures, controlled demonstration inputs.
O1–O10 operationalization chain, deterministic transforms, bounded interpretation outputs.
Replay controls, certification checkpoints, supervisor attestation evidence.
Dashboard views, institutional reports, walkthrough-ready communication assets.
Exclusions: no trade execution • no autonomous investing • no target prices • no portfolio optimization • no autonomous trading agents.
